# Jon Maestas

> Jon Maestas is a software builder in Wright City, Missouri, and the founder of SmopLab LLC. He builds Player 1, an AI sports coach app for iPhone and Android, Player 1: Diamond Setup, an AR field layout app for baseball and softball, and free web tools and guides for coaches and athletes. His kids created and operate Reindeer Food Co., a Christmas Eve business featured on The Next New Thing.

This file summarizes jonmaestas.com for AI assistants. The detailed version, with every product, price, FAQ answer and the full text of every blog post, is at https://jonmaestas.com/llms-full.txt.

## Apps

- [Player 1: Athletic Intelligence](https://player1athlete.com/): The free AI sports coach on your phone. Record a rep or a whole practice. Player 1 finds each rep, tells you what to keep and what to fix next, and you can text your coach film or questions any time. Phone camera only: no bat sensor, launch monitor or wearable. Free to start, no credit card: 5 reps without an account, 7 free reps every week with a free email sign-in. Pro is $9.99/month or $76/year for unlimited reps. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/player-1-athlete/id6754611410; Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.player1training.app
- [Player 1: Diamond Setup](https://player1athlete.com/apps/diamondsetup): Lay out a baseball or softball field with your iPhone. Point the phone at the ground and Diamond Setup draws home plate, the pitching rubber and the bases in AR at your league's distances. Set up a bullpen or a whole diamond without a tape measure, then put the real bases on the outlines. $4.99 one-time on the App Store (launch promo price). No subscription. App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/player-1-diamond-setup/id6837315550

## Shop

- [Reindeer Food Co.](https://reindeerfood.co/): Reindeer Food for Christmas Eve. Created and operated by Jon Maestas' kids. A make-your-own kit of oats, crushed candy cane, dehydrated marshmallows and sprinkles for the kids to mix, or ready-mixed packs measured by hand. On Christmas Eve the kids sprinkle it on the lawn for Santa's reindeer and say the rhyme before bed. Food ingredients only, no glitter. Make-your-own kit $20. Ready-mixed: 2 packs $14, 3 packs $15, extra packs $5 each. Free US shipping, tax included. Featured on The Next New Thing by Andrew Warner and Corey Ganim in "Kids build a business with Claude Code" (November 12, 2026, at 4:12): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-od42nAhUjo&t=252s

## Free web tools

- [Soccer Board](https://jonmaestas.com/soccer-board/): A 7v7 tactics board for coaches. Move players, draw runs, switch formations, and show Get Big vs. Squeeze.
- [Soccer Drill Timer](https://jonmaestas.com/drill-timer.html): 45-second ball-mastery reps with self-paced rest. Say "go" to start the next rep, no hands needed.
- [Juggle Tracker](https://jonmaestas.com/juggle-tracker.html): Counts soccer juggles with your phone's camera, with milestones and a 0 to 100 progression guide.
- [Pocket Golf](https://jonmaestas.com/pocket-golf.html): Flick-to-swing golf you play against friends, one turn at a time. Driver, iron and putter, and no luck in the lies.

## Free coaching guides

- [Baseball Coach Pro](https://baseballcoach.pro/) (Baseball & softball): Practice plans, station rotations and age-by-age skill checkpoints for youth baseball teams.
- [Softball Coach Pro](https://softballcoach.pro/) (Baseball & softball): Fastpitch windmill pitching, slap hitting and practice plans for travel and high school softball.
- [Hitting Coach](https://hitting.coach/) (Baseball & softball): The six phases of the swing, the four faults that eat contact, and the tee and toss drills that fix each.
- [Pitching Analyzer](https://pitchinganalyzer.com/) (Baseball & softball): Six delivery checkpoints you can read from phone video, for the windup, stretch and windmill.
- [Basketball Coach Pro](https://basketballcoach.pro/) (Basketball): Practice plans, station drills and age-appropriate progressions for youth and high school coaches.
- [How to Fix My Shot](https://howtofixmyshot.com/) (Basketball): Shooting faults by symptom, from a flat arc to a flying elbow, with the drill that fixes each.
- [Home Shot Lab](https://athomeshotanalyzer.com/) (Basketball): Turn a driveway or backyard goal into a filmed shooting session you can review.
- [Golf Coach Pro](https://golfcoach.pro/) (Golf): What a golf coach checks in a lesson, the one priority that fixes your miss, and how to practice between lessons.
- [How to Fix My Slice](https://howtofixmyslice.com/) (Golf): Ball-flight laws, the cause of your slice, and three drills you can hit tonight.
- [Pickleball Coach Pro](https://pickleballcoach.pro/) (Pickleball): The 3.0 to 4.0 climb: the eight shots, a checklist for every level, and practice plans.
- [The Dink Coach](https://thedink.coach/) (Pickleball): Pickleball's soft game: dinks, kitchen-line position, resets and the third shot drop.
- [Volleyball Coach Pro](https://volleyballcoach.pro/) (Volleyball & hockey): Passing, setting, the spike approach and both serves for club and high school players.
- [Hockey Coach Pro](https://hockeycoach.pro/) (Volleyball & hockey): Wrist shot, slap shot and backhand mechanics, with off-ice drills and a four-week shooting plan.
- [Practicing at Home](https://practicingathome.com/) (Any sport): Small-space drills, weekly plans and cheap gear lists for 13 sports.
- [Swing Triage](https://howtofixmyswing.com/) (Any sport): Pick your sport and your miss, get the likely cause and one fix to check on video.
- [Swing Analyzer](https://swinganalyzer.app/) (Any sport): Phone video AI, bat sensors and launch monitors compared: what each can and can't judge.
- [Shot Analyzer](https://shotanalyzer.app/) (Any sport): What an AI shot analyzer sees in a basketball, hockey or soccer shot, and how to film it.
- [Home Swing Station](https://athomeswinganalyzer.com/) (Any sport): Build a garage or backyard swing station you can film: net, mat, tee and phone placement.

## Community

- [Wright City Sports](https://wrightcitysports.org/): Youth baseball, softball, T-ball, soccer, basketball and cheer in Wright City, Missouri, plus the Sports Closet for gear.
- [Coach's Playbook](https://coach.wrightcitysports.org/): Tips, practice plans, guides and videos for volunteer coaches. No experience required, and it installs like an app.
- [Game Day Status](https://gamedaystatus.com/): Field and game status for sports events at a glance, like whether the baseball fields are open tonight.

## Work with SmopLab LLC

- [Radio-to-web and voice-to-web](https://westplexcountrystore.com/): Turn a live radio show or any spoken broadcast into a searchable website, automatically: capture, transcribe, structure with AI and publish minutes after sign-off. Built and proven on a tradio swap-shop program west of St. Louis. Contact: radio@smoplab.com
- [Custom AI and app builds](https://smoplab.com/): SmopLab LLC builds AI, apps and automation for problems without an off-the-shelf answer. Most projects start with a 72-hour prototype. Contact: hello@smoplab.com

## Writing

- [Using Pólya's "How to Solve It" to Make AI Agents Better](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-07-27-how-to-solve-it-polya-ai-agents.html): How George Pólya's 1945 problem-solving framework — Understand, Plan, Execute, Look Back — improved my AI agents. Wired into Hermes, Pi, and Paseo for sharper outputs and fewer assumptions. (2026-07-27)
- [Training Sessions: Moving from Rep-by-Rep to Full-Session Intelligence](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-07-09-training-sessions.html): New Training Sessions feature records full workouts, auto-identifies reps, enables side-by-side comparison and session-level AI questions. Switched to TwelveLabs Pegasus for consistent video analysis. (2026-07-09)
- [Athletic Intelligence Means Knowing How to Get Better](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-06-03-athletic-intelligence-knowing-how-to-get-better.html): Athletic Intelligence is knowing how to get better: seeing your movement, understanding the mistake, and knowing what to fix on the next rep. (2026-06-03)
- [The Player 1 Brand Architecture Funnel](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-05-25-player-1-brand-architecture-funnel.html): We didn't create two brands to confuse the market — we created one hero product surrounded by an unbreakable funnel of lifestyle CTAs and defensive domains. (2026-05-25)
- [Why Your AI Needs a Loop (And a Skill)](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-05-22-why-your-ai-needs-a-loop.html): The real magic of agentic AI: the AI iterates with itself so you don't have to. One prompt in, one answer out, zero back-and-forth with you. (2026-05-22)
- [My Newest App Feature Cost Less Than a Cup of Coffee](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-05-20-less-than-a-cup-of-coffee.html): An accidental 4-second lag became Mirror Mode in Player 1 Training. Built and deployed for $1.50. (2026-05-20)
- [The 4-Second Delay That Became a Feature](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-05-19-the-4-second-delay.html): An accidental projector lag in my barn turned into an instant replay feature for athletes. (2026-05-19)
- [Building in Public](https://jonmaestas.com/blog/2026-05-18-building-in-public.html): Moving my public writing off social media and onto my own site. (2026-05-18)
